title: Noam & Tyreese
description: Noam finds Tyreese's phone in a bar after his sister Romy's birthday party. While searching through the device, he discovers that Tyreese is obsessed with Romy.

questions.question: The owner's wallpaper is weird. Can you tell me if it's a girl or a guy?
questions.hint: Open the photo gallery and look for a selfie photo of the owner

questions.question: I had a feeling. What's his first and last name?
questions.hint: Look in the Wallet app for the train ticket (Passes section) to find the last name, then check the SMS to confirm the first name

questions.question: That tells me nothing... How old is he? Maybe he's a friend of Romy's.
questions.hint: Open the Health app and look at the profile with the measurements

questions.question: Oh yeah he's 4 years older than my sister so weird that he'd be her friend. Where did he go after the birthday party yesterday?
questions.hint: Look in the Calendar at yesterday's date to find a note at 11pm

questions.question: Red Room? What is that place?
questions.hint: Search in Safari for an open tab with 'Red Room'

questions.question: Oh yeah I remember, my sister and her friends went there after the pre-drinks at the bar. But wait, I thought they went there just girls only. What was he doing there?
questions.hint: Open the Notes app and look for a note titled 'Operation Red Room'

questions.question: Too weird, I asked my sister Romy if she knew this guy, she's never heard of him. Find me what neighborhood he lives in
questions.hint: Look at his runs in Strava and the status mentioning a bagel shop, then check in ChatGPT for the exact address of this business

questions.question: But that's our neighborhood! Has he ever run into my sister? If so, tell me where?
questions.hint: Open Hinge and find Romy's profile with a conversation where he mentions seeing her somewhere

questions.question: This guy gives me bad vibes... What's his Insta username? I'm going to try asking around if anyone knows him
questions.hint: In Hinge, look for a conversation with Theodora where he gives his Instagram username

questions.question: I sent the username to my sister, she told me he's a psychopath who's been stalking her for weeks! What the hell, how did he know it was Romy's birthday yesterday?
questions.hint: Go back to Romy's profile in Hinge and read her bio

questions.question: I had warned Romy to never put personal info on social media... How did he know where to go?
questions.hint: Open the Find My app and look for a tracking device

questions.question: What?? This guy is sick! Romy won't answer me anymore, tell me where she is right now!
questions.hint: In Find My, look where the SpyRomy AirTag is currently located

questions.question: OK, she's surrounded but this guy has placed a tracker in her bag... he's waiting for the right moment. Why Romy? There must be a reason for this obsession.
questions.hint: Look in the SMS for an old conversation with Mom that talks about an ex

questions.question: Sarah... an ex? He must have photos of her in his hidden folder to compare to Romy. I need the code for the Hidden Gallery.
questions.hint: Look in Notes, there's a photo code hidden in a note

questions.question: So? What is he hiding in his gallery?
questions.hint: Open the hidden photo gallery with the code and look at what's inside

questions.question: This guy is crazy, he's making photo montages with Romy and him... Where is he right now? Look carefully, he must have left a clue.
questions.hint: Look in Gmail for an email from Dr. OUL Mabe with an appointment today, then look in Safari for the office address

questions.question: Give me his psychiatrist's number, I'm going to call him, now!
questions.hint: Open the Phone app and look for the contact 'Psy Clinique'

questions.question: The doctor just told me he never showed up! He has a red car according to him, find the license plate so I can alert the police in front of the museum!
questions.hint: Look in SMS for a message about a Tesla, then in the photo gallery find the photo of the red car and zoom in on the plate

textSuccess: Damn, thank you! I called the police, they're on their way to the museum. This sicko has been stalking my sister for weeks, he even put an AirTag in her bag! He's in his father's red Tesla. I hope they arrest him before he does something to Romy. Thanks for everything, without you I never would have known...

onboardingContent.text: Hey... My name is Noam. I don't really know how to explain this, but I really need your help. It's about my sister Romy.
Last night was Romy's birthday at Pub O'Sullivan in Montréal. Everyone was there, amazing atmosphere... until Tyreese disappeared without warning.
Tyreese Boucher, 24 years old. He's been hanging out with us for a few months. But now he left his phone at the bar and no one's been able to reach him since.
I got his phone... and I started looking through it. What I found freaks me out for my sister. Can you help me dig through it?

messages.text: Eh, your mother and I are worried about you
You don't leave the house anymore, you don't answer our calls
Tyresse, you're scaring mom and me
Dad I don't want to talk about it
That girl broke your heart and you act like nothing happened
I don't need this right now
Yes you do need it! You think we can't see that you're not doing well?
But promise me you'll think about it
By the way, can you bring back the Tesla this week?
I need it to go see grandma Thursday
Tyreese, bring the Tesla back right now!
Ok ok I'm coming right away
Your mother is making your favorite dish for tonight
About you. About your behavior since Sarah left
Yes it is! You spend your days looking for a replacement
You're looking for Sarah in each of them
I don't know what you're talking about
Tyreese, stop looking for a replacement for your ex Sarah, it won't bring her back.
This obsession is going to destroy you
And it hurts me to see you like this
You're my son and I love you
But you need to get yourself together
Yo man what are you doing tomorrow?
Idk man I'm not really in the mood
Come on bro it'll be good for you

If you change your mind let me know

Hey! Are you coming to yoga class tomorrow?
Come on! It'll help you relax
All the more reason to come!
Hi Tyreese! Thanks for the coffee this morning

photos.imageDescription: 24-year-old man, young adult, blond, Caucasian, short curly hair, trimmed beard, charming smile, casual urban style with hoodie and cap. Mirror selfie of a mysterious man taken in a white-tiled bathroom. The man wears a black hoodie with the hood up that partially hides his face in shadow. You can see a trimmed beard and blond curly hair slightly showing from under the hood. The dim lighting created by a ceiling bulb casts dramatic shadows on his face, making his features difficult to distinguish clearly. The phone hides part of his face but you can identify that it's indeed a man by his stature and masculine silhouette. The overall atmosphere is dark and mysterious.

Photo of the red Tesla car with license plate TY-666-RK parked in a well-lit underground parking garage. The cherry red Tesla Model 3 gleams under the white neon lights of the parking garage. The license plate TY-666-RK is clearly visible at the rear of the vehicle, with white letters and numbers on a Quebec blue background perfectly readable. The gray concrete floor contrasts with the metallic red body. Other blurred cars can be seen in the background. The photo is taken from a distance allowing the entire vehicle and its license plate to be seen clearly and precisely.

hiddenPhotos.imageDescription: 24-year-old man, young adult, blond, Caucasian, short curly hair, trimmed beard, charming smile, casual urban style with hoodie and cap. Photo of Sarah and Tyreese where he made a crude photomontage with Romy's head on Sarah's. You see Tyreese smiling in a gray hoodie, his arm around a woman's shoulders. But the woman's head has been clumsily replaced with Romy's - a young Afro-Canadian woman with long curly hair and a bright smile. The photomontage is visible because the proportions don't match perfectly, the skin color doesn't blend naturally at the neck level, and the shadows are inconsistent. The background shows the interior of the café where they work, with espresso machines and shelves of cups blurred behind them.

chatgptConversations.title: Running spots and cafés in Montréal

messages.content: Hey! Got any tips for enjoying Montréal after my barista shifts? I'm interested in spots for running and for a good espresso.

- Parc du Mont Royal for quick uphill runs ⛰️
- Lachine Canal for a light jog by the water 🏃‍♂️💧
- Local cafés near the routes for a ristretto after your run ☕
Give me information about bagel shops in Montréal.
St-Viateur Bagels located in the Mile End neighborhood
Hey! After my barista shifts, what quick routes do you recommend for running around downtown? 🏃‍♂️

- Canal Lachine in the evening for a smooth stride and water views 🌊
- Mont-Royal for some hills and short sprints 🪨
- Vieux-Montréal for a flat route with plenty of cafés ☕🏙️
As a barista, what methods do you use to get a perfect espresso at work? ☕

- Dose ratio: 18–20 g for 36–40 g extraction (1:2) 😎
- Fine and even grind, firm and consistent tamping
- Water temperature around 90°C and stable pressure
- Calibrated grinder and milk steamer dialed in for microfoam 🎯
Do you often take photos in the city? Any tips on natural light? 📷

- Take advantage of golden hour for warm tones and soft shadows 🌅
- Look for reflections in shop windows and poles
- Use RAW mode or light post-processing to keep the details
- Simple tools: a mini tripod and a 35mm lens ❤️
Any plans for this weekend? 😄

- Saturday: trying out a new café and photo shoot in the park 📸☕
- Sunday: morning run + brunch with friends 🥞🏃‍♀️
- We can also share stories on social media!
Do you know any photogenic cafés for Instagram stories? 📷✨

- Café Olimpico: retro vibe and colorful walls 🎨
- Le 5e Café: big windows and natural light 😍
- Café Vienne: patios and chic industrial decor 🧡
I'm thinking about buying a grinder for work. Which one would you recommend?

- Baratza Encore to start with, reliable and affordable ☕
- Hario Skerton Pro for tight budget but practical
- If you're going upmarket: Baratza Sette 270Wi for precision and speed 🚀
How do you organize your training in winter in Montréal? ❄️

- Gym sessions and treadmill runs when the weather's harsh 🏃‍♂️💨
- Routine: 10 min warm-up then 6–8 km at steady pace
- Recovery with stretching and strengthening | stay hydrated 💧
Tell me a fun story about an order that went wrong but ended well. 😄

- Customer asks for 'latte art' shaped like a dinosaur, we improvise with the foam and end up with a smile 😅🦖
- We all laugh together, + generous tip and guided tour of the café's décor ☕🎨
Do you know where to find a running club in Montréal? 🏃‍♂️

- Local group on Meetup: easy runs on weekday evenings
- Mont-Royal park running club: guided outings
- Community app: find running partners near you 🏃❤️

safariTabs.title: Marathon training plan - Runner's World
safariTabs.content:
# Runner's World

## Marathon training plan - 16 weeks

![marathon runner](https://imgcaller.3t.net.vn/MobileDetective/v1/_external/images.unsplash.com/photo-1544717297-fa95b6ee9643_41266040.jpg)

---

### Week 1-4: Base Building

**Goal:** Build a solid foundation
**Weekly mileage:** 40-50 km

**Week 3 example:**
- **Monday:** Rest or cross-training
- **Tuesday:** 8 km easy
- **Wednesday:** 6 km tempo
- **Thursday:** 5 km recovery
- **Friday:** Rest
- **Saturday:** 12 km long run
- **Sunday:** 6 km easy

---

### Week 5-8: Build Up

**Goal:** Increase volume
**Weekly mileage:** 55-65 km

**Key sessions:**
- Long runs: 16-20 km
- Tempo runs: 8-10 km
- Intervals: 6x1000m

---

### Nutrition tips

- **Hydration:** 500ml/hour of effort
- **Carbohydrates:** 30-60g/hour after 1h30
- **Testing:** Always test during training

### Recovery

- **Sleep:** 7-9h per night
- **Stretching:** 15-20 min post-run
- **Massage:** 1x per week

---
